Meeting header:
Date: 2025-06-18 15:00 UTC
Duration: 55 minutes
Attendees: Lena Park, Omar Ruiz, Priya Nair (Redwood); Marcus Lee, Anika Shah, David Cho (CloudSphere Labs)

[00:00] Lena: hey everyone, thanks for joining, um this is our partner webinar sync, I think main goal is to lock down who does what and the demo flow so we don't scramble in the wet run.
[00:18] Marcus: yep thanks lena, appreciate it. Quick note: CloudSphere wants the developer angle up front — more of a how-to — and then the platform economics at the end.
[00:30] Priya: makes sense. I built a rough cadence for outreach, it's kinda three touchpoints: save the date, full invite, reminder + partner shoutout. we'll include utm_source=partner and separate hubspot lists.
[00:45] Omar: can we call out the co-marketing assets? like logos, 1-pagers, and the 60s clip we can share with partners. also do we want a joint landing page or separate tracking?
[01:00] Anika: pref joint landing page — easier for reporting but we need the embed code for the register widget from Redwood. David, is there any constraint on the fields?
[01:12] David: keep form minimal — name, email, company, one checkbox for 'developer interest' — otherwise conversion drops.
[01:22] Lena: agreed. Priya, can you make two versions of the form — short and long? we'll use short on partners.
[01:30] Priya: yeah will do. question — who's owning the eventbrite vs hubspot thing. we prefer hubspot registration.
[01:38] Marcus: cloud prefers hubspot too, so that's good.
[01:42] Omar: quick ops Q — platform: Zoom webinar is easiest for our AV team, but ON24 has richer engagement. Any strong preference?
[01:52] Anika: we're leaning Zoom for simplicity, but if Redwood wants Q&A widgets, we need to confirm integrations.
[02:00] Lena: we can do Zoom + Slido or use Zoom native Q&A. For the demo, here's the key decision: live demo or pre-recorded deep dive? We were thinking hybrid: short live demo to show core flow, then a pre-recorded 8-10 minute deep demo to avoid run-of-show risk.
[02:20] Marcus: hybrid sounds good. live for the wow, prerecorded for the complex stuff. Also can we insert a brief architecture slide that mentions private deployments and dedicated? don't over-sell.
[02:32] Priya: yes lean technical but not a product deep dive. Omar — need a list of screenshots from you for the one-pager.
[02:40] Omar: I'll export the flows, but heads up, some labels in the UI have old copy — might cause transcript mismatch in the deck, will update.
[02:50] Speaker 1: (inaudible) — sorry, was that — are we planning a partner-specific promo code or a UTM only?
[02:58] Lena: UTM only, but we'll provide partner-specific landing links. No promo codes for this one.
[03:06] Marcus: promo codes complicate reporting, agreed.
[03:10] Anika: what's the registration target?
[03:14] Priya: target 800 registrants, 12-15% attendance expected so ~100 live. Partners should drive 200 of the registrants.
[03:25] David: logging: can we add a checkbox to ask about private deployment interest? that will help SDRs route leads.
[03:32] Lena: sure, that's the 'developer interest' field, we'll add 'private deployment' as an option.
[03:38] Omar: on promotion windows — recommend 4-week lead time: week 0 teaser, week 2 full invite, week 3 reminder, 48hr + 2hr push. Partners should have the full assets week 1.
[03:52] Marcus: we'll need the email copy and creative. can you do a one-pager with subject line options?
[03:57] Priya: yes, I'll draft 3 subject options and A/B test the winner.
[04:03] Lena: run-of-show — propose: intro (5 mins), market context (7), live demo (10), prerecorded deep demo (8), Q&A (20), close + CTA (5). That totals ~55.
[04:20] Anika: question on Q&A moderation — do we want Redwood SE to moderate live?
[04:26] Marcus: yes, Redwood SE is best to handle live technical Qs.
[04:30] Lena: we'll have Priya moderate chat and triage to SE — SE to answer technical ones. Need to schedule a dry run 2 days before.
[04:40] David: is there an embargo policy? partners sometimes want exclusives.
[04:44] Marcus: we can offer a 48-hour exclusive email to top partners before general promotion.
[04:50] Omar: assets — I can make a 60s promo clip (short montage + CTA), static banners (3 sizes), social cards (2 variants), and a 1-pager. Need confirmed slides and logos by 6/23.
[05:05] Priya: attribution: set campaign=partner_webinar, source=partnername, medium=email/social. We'll add campaign in hubspot form hidden fields.
[05:15] Lena: tracking is critical — we want a UTM for each partner so we can measure partner contribution and commit to co-marketing credits.
[05:24] Anika: about the demo environment: will Redwood provide a demo tenant or should CloudSphere spin up a sandbox?
[05:31] Lena: Redwood can spin up a demo tenant with sample data — SE will provision. But if CloudSphere wants to show their integration, they should pre-record that piece.
[05:40] Marcus: we'll probably pre-record the integration bit, good call.
[05:44] Omar: any concerns about compliance / data in the demo? we should avoid showing real PII.
[05:50] David: agree, sanitize everything.
[05:53] Lena: ok final checklist: speaker bios, headshots, promo assets, deck w/ timestamps, hubspot form, partner list, dry-run schedule.
[06:03] Marcus: timeline check — webinar date proposed 2025-07-10, dry run 2025-07-08, asset freeze 2025-06-26. Is that feasible?
[06:14] Priya: yes if we lock deck by 6/23.
[06:18] Lena: next steps recap: I'll send run-of-show + deck template. Priya will create forms and cadence. Omar produce creative. Marcus share partner list. Anika confirm platform.
[06:30] Anika: we need a backup plan if the SE is out — who covers?
[06:34] Lena: Omar can do basic live demo, SE lead (TBD) will cover deep technical Qs. We'll confirm backup by 6/25.
[06:42] Speaker 1: (crosstalk) — ok that sounds good.
[06:45] Lena: any other Qs?
[06:47] David: none from me.
[06:48] Marcus: all good.
[06:50] Priya: I'll follow up with an email summary and the first draft of outreach copy.
[06:55] Lena: great thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after assets are shared.
